title: GAP Waiver Premier 150 Exclusions: Number of Past-Due Installments Counted
content:
**Item of the GAP Waiver Addenda Premier 150 exclusion schedule.** This item sets how many past-due installments the past-due part of the Premier excluded total counts.

The count depends on how many installments the Premier excluded total treats as past due on the Retail Installment Contracts contract: the installments still unpaid that fell due on or before the date of loss.

| Installments treated as past due | Installments counted in the past-due part |
|---|---|
| one | none |
| two | one |
| three or more | all of them |
| none | none |

Two boundary cases:

- With exactly two installments treated as past due, the past-due part counts one.
- With three, it counts all three.
